manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the mug beige smooth cylinder shape on the table, rotate it, set it down in the middle, then hang it onto the dark gray rack with flat back.

Task description: Operate the beige cylindrical handled cup on the left side of the table. Rotate it and set it down temporarily at the center of the table, then hang it on the rack on the right with a flat base and angled bar.

Success criteria: The cup handle surrounds the rack's slanted rod. The cup is horizontally near the hanging area around the rack's middle, well clear of the table, and at the hanging height supported by the rod. The right gripper is open and has released it.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the mug rim-wall away from the handle, one finger inside and one outside, opening slightly wider than the wall. Confirm actual pad contact, leaving room to fit the handle over the rod.
- Leave room for the cup handle to swing during rotation. If temporarily placing it in the center of the table, release only after the base is stably supported to avoid tipping when the handle or rim touches the table first.
- To place the handle over the rod, orient the handle opening toward the free end of the angled rod and make small adjustments along its slope. Avoid hitting the rod end with the handle edge or cup body.
- Before release, lower gently so the inside of the cup handle rests on the rack bar and bears its weight, then open the gripper gradually. Avoid losing support before the handle is hung.
